findings.title: deps(frontend): simple-zstd is pinned pending a code change that was never made
findings.unverifiable: Did not run the real `npm run dev-server` against a Flask backend serving content-encoding: zstd HTML (no backend in this environment); the proxy path was exercised only via the jest tests that wire getProxyConfig() into http-proxy-middleware with a real HTTP backend. GitHub CI was still running at time of report.

findings.title: test(frontend): 205 un-awaited userEvent calls across 52 files, and the lint rule that catches them is disabled
findings.unverifiable: The flakes described in the issue were not reproduced locally (all 15 suites passed on the base branch), so the fix is demonstrated by static inspection and passing tests rather than by observing a flake disappear. The await-async-events rule is not exercised by the main `npm run lint` CI job (oxlint lacks a testing-library plugin); it only runs via the ESLint minimal config used by the tech-debt lint-stats workflow (continue-on-error). Corrected files under packages/ and plugins/ are globally ignored by eslint.config.minimal.js so the per-file 'error' override does not cover them.

findings.title: security-triage: xlsx advisories cannot be resolved by upgrade and will recur on every scan
findings.unverifiable: The suppression's effect on the scanner (remediation-agent / OSV-based) was not observed; that scanner does not consume dependabot.yml, so the finding may still surface there. Dependabot's acceptance of the `versions` constraint was validated only by YAML parsing and pre-commit (check-yaml, zizmor), not by a Dependabot run. PR CI was still running at time of report.

findings.title: deps(frontend): the react-checkbox-tree suppression's stated conditions are now met — retry the upgrade
findings.unverifiable: Did not run the full Superset app (webpack dev-server + Flask backend) and open a dashboard's filter-scope UI in a browser locally; the runtime failure was demonstrated/refuted via an equivalent standalone webpack+react-refresh harness in headless Chrome plus inspection of the real `build-dev` DashboardContainer chunk. CI Cypress/Playwright E2E suites passed on the PR, but those run production bundles, not the react-refresh dev build. Visual appearance of the filter-scope tree after the .rct-title/.rct-options CSS renames was not checked in a browser.
